column1: # The grammar this engine's committed answers come from. No Cassandra server
# judges yet, so default is no image: it is Apache Cassandra's CQL grammar,
# src/antlr/Cql.g, Parser.g and Lexer.g, at the commit of the release in the
# source tag. The digest is the SHA-256 of those three files, beside this one
# byte for byte, read one after the other. Cql.g4, which the rows are
# generated from and judged by, is converted from them by
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
